statement: An evidence ingest seam with no explicit version and permissive coercion can silently record less evidence than its producer supplied: unknown dimensions or severities disappear, missing values are invented, and out-of-range values are normalized without a contract boundary. Version the input with major.minor semantics, reject unversioned and unknown-major documents rather than guessing, reserve unknown fields for additive same-major changes, and test a real consumer fixture end to end. For record-only evidence, use zero score weight and mechanically assert that native insufficient_data remains insufficient_data. When a deterministic report's bytes are already an attested invariant, carry the report-format version in the bound attestation instead of mutating the report, and pin the unchanged report hash before implementation.
quarantineReason: This staging record accompanies the Evidence Seam v1 branch, whose eventual squash commit does not yet exist on Cejel origin/main. It must not anchor to its own branch.
moveCondition: After the Evidence Seam v1 PR merges, identify its 40-character squash commit on Cejel origin/main and verify that its diff versions the generic ingest contract, rejects unknown majors, carries reportFormatVersion in the bound attestation, and adds the predeclared no-ingest report hash plus heal-log abstention tests. Then copy this record into Alfred docs/orchestration/maeve-lesson-batches/ with the required cejel_ filename prefix and that origin/main commit anchor.
